comment: Accounts / auth / desktop domain — the P5 slice behind the Accounts
Schema and rules: see 00-foundation.json. This file is additive; the
src-tauri/src/dto_error.rs read every *.json in this directory and
reject a code claimed by two files.
desktop_backend owns four enums rather than the one
rules/rust-conventions.md asks for. Only its boundary error takes
the bare module segment; the other three are namespaced by the
concern they carry, so a translator reading `desktop_key.*` knows
it is about retrieving the safeStorage secret and not about a swap.
